# DeepInfra provider for DeepSeek Harness

Use DeepInfra models from DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).
The plugin registers a `deepinfra` provider rout
e and streams over DeepInfra's OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API.
- **Live model catalog.** Models come from `GET https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai/models`, so new

DeepInfra models appear without a plugin update. Only chat models are listed.
- **Real model facts.*
* Each model reports its own context window, image input (`vision`), and reasoning-effort levels. Co

mpaction timing and the model picker use these values, so nothing has to be typed into settings.
- *
*Tool calls, reasoning, and images.** Parallel tool calls, `reasoning_content` (also sent back on la

ter turns so thinking models can continue a tool loop), and image input on vision models.
- **Prompt
caching.** The DSH session id goes out as `prompt_cache_key`, so repeated turns reuse their cached

prefix.
- **No conflict with your own routes.** It adds a route beside `llm-pi-ai` and does not modi

.
- **No conflict with your own routes.** It adds a route beside `llm-pi-ai` and does not modify it.

## Configuration
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai` | OpenAI-compatible API root |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `
DEEPINFRA_API_KEY` | Credential reference resolved for each request through the DSH credential servi
ce, or from the environment when the composition has none |
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Behavior
- The catalog is cached for 10 minutes. If the listing is unreachable, the last good listing is serv
ed, or a small built-in list if there was never one, so the route never comes up empty. A model id m
issing from the listing (for example, a private deployment) can still be requested; its context wind

ow is reported as unknown rather than guessed.
- Without an API key the picker lists no DeepInfra mo

dels, because every request would fail.
- Reasoning: models DeepInfra tags `reasoning_effort` offer
`Off`, `Low`, `Medium`, `High`; models tagged only `reasoning` offer `Off`/`On` (`none`/`high` on th
e wire). The choice goes out as `reasoning_effort`, and leaving it unset keeps the model's own defau

lt. Some models, such as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, do not think unless you turn it on.
- HTTP failures ma
p to DSH failure codes: `401` → `INVALID_CREDENTIAL`, `402` or quota text → `QUOTA`, `429` → `RATE_L
IMIT` (with `Retry-After`), context-overflow `400` → `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, `5xx` → `SERVER`. `d

sh-llm-retry` retries the transient ones.
- Images go inline as base64 data URLs, scaled to ~4 MP an
d 1 MiB each. When one request's images exceed 20 MiB, DSH is asked to offload the oldest ones.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The tests include a contract check: every `GenerateOptions` field declared by the installed `@deepse
ek-ai/dsh-llm` must have an entry in `REQUEST_FIELD_DISPOSITION` (`lib/request.js`). When DSH adds a
request field, the test fails until the field is handled or deliberately ignored.
